title: Prove ConPTY and Job Object lifecycle
starting_commit_note: The supplied bootstrap workspace is not a Git checkout; authority and source hashes are used as the immutable starting reference.

prerequisites.required_output: Repository skeleton, pinned toolchain, deterministic build settings, and isolated prototype paths

global_invariants: Closing an observer must not be represented as process cancellation.
A lack of terminal output alone is not a failure or termination signal.
Known lifecycle scenarios use deterministic process, stream, and Job Object signals only.
Prototype code remains isolated and is not referenced by production projects.
Hard stop is explicit and separately exercised from graceful Ctrl+C cancellation.

acceptance.result: All eleven declared lifecycle scenarios pass 100 consecutive reliability repetitions.
Each scenario records one, four, and eight concurrent-session groups with CPU, working set, output latency, transfer bytes, and handle metrics.
No observed root or descendant process remains after normal cleanup, hard stop, or owner crash.
acceptance.verifier: Process identity and Job Object reconciliation

acceptance.result: Harness handle growth remains within the predeclared tolerance after scenario and scale checkpoints.
acceptance.verifier: Process.HandleCount checkpoints after forced GC/finalizer stabilization

acceptance.result: The proof records the selected architecture boundary for live ConPTY reattachment after owner failure without claiming reattachment support.

expected_outputs: Narrow x64 Win32 interop for ConPTY, Job Objects, process launch, resize, input, output, metrics, and teardown
Deterministic fixture executable covering Unicode, ANSI, burst, quiet child, stdin, resize, exit, crash, graceful cancel, forced stop, and nested descendants
Manifest-driven reliability, scale, leak, owner-crash, and evidence harness
Source-contract validator, unit-style console tests, proof documentation, validation log, and completion receipt
discretion: Internal helper class and file names may change without changing evidence semantics.
Sampling implementation may change if all declared metrics, freshness, and process-identity checks remain explicit.
No production API, protocol, schema, scheduler policy, or adapter contract may be introduced by this proof.
stop_conditions: A target CLI cannot operate correctly through ConPTY.
A normal current-user process cannot contain its ordinary descendants in the proof Job Object.
The 100-run harness leaks a process tree or exceeds the predeclared handle-growth tolerance.
Evidence cannot distinguish graceful cancellation, hard stop, crash, and owner failure.
A required change would reference prototype code from a production project.
